title: Long Waits for Toy Car Races
story: Kids are waiting a long time to race their new RCCR toy cars. The place that helps kids race is super busy, and everyone wants to join!
storyBig: The demand for RCCR toy car races is extremely high, causing long wait times for kids eager to participate. The organizers are working hard to reduce the waiting period, but the popularity of these races has made it challenging.
think: Why might long waits happen when something is very popular?
bull: RCCR toy cars are so fun that everyone wants to race!
bear: Waiting a long time might make kids lose interest.

title: Juice Prices Zoom Due to Fruit Shortage
story: Oh no! JUCE drinks are costing more because there aren't enough fruits. This makes it harder to make yummy fruit drinks.
storyBig: A shortage in fruit supply is causing the price of JUCE products to increase. This scarcity is impacting production costs and consequently the retail price of their popular fruit drinks.
think: What can happen to prices when there's not enough of something?
bull: Maybe JUCE will find new fruits to make interesting drinks!
bear: Higher prices might mean fewer kids can buy JUCE.
